No malicious code execution, data exfiltration, or unsafe operations occur during the sourcing phase of this PKGBUILD. All content in the global scope is declarative and consistent with standard AUR packaging practices.

There are no signs of malicious behavior such as network exfiltration, execution of downloaded code, obfuscation, or unauthorized system modifications.
